about: Markham is a suburban city in York Region, immediately north of Toronto. It is one of Canada’s most diverse municipalities and a centre for technology and Chinese-Canadian business. Much of the city is post-war subdivision and newer high-rise nodes along Highway 7. About 340,000 people live in Markham.
seoSummary: Diverse York Region city north of Toronto, with a large tech and Asian business corridor.
knownFor: Large Chinese and South Asian communities
Pacific Mall and other Asian retail centres
Household incomes above the Toronto average
